prompt: Create an eight-slide seed fundraising deck for an AI support startup. The audience is skeptical early-stage investors.

requirements.description: The process anchors the deck in an audience and a desired decision.
requirements.repair: State the audience and the decision or action the deck must produce before outlining slides.

requirements.description: Claims have evidence and source notes.
requirements.repair: Support consequential claims with evidence and add source notes with direct links or document references.

requirements.description: Each slide carries one message and an answer-first title.
requirements.repair: Keep one idea per slide and write an answer-first title that states the slide's conclusion.

requirements.description: Every content slide has a concrete visual treatment.
requirements.repair: Give every content slide a visual plan naming the chart, diagram, image, or layout and the data or message it carries.
